text:
maya: heads-up on a docs PR about autoscale policies migrating from per-direction cooldowns to cooldown_seconds map
 diego: link?
maya: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4988 i updated examples but sims disagree with local runtime
felix: what's the CLI you used to reproduce?
maya: ./tools/traffic-sim --cfg examples/dedicated/autoscale-migrate.yaml --runs 50
maya: old snippet in docs:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 8
  scale_out_cooldown: 30
  scale_in_cooldown: 300
```
felix: runtime expects `cooldown_seconds.scale_out` / `cooldown_seconds.scale_in` — using the old keys is effectively ignored, so bursts don't scale out
diego: propose: 1) update YAML examples to runtime schema, 2) add a small migration blurb mapping old keys, 3) include a Go SDK snippet showing construction + validation
maya: adding Go snippet now
```go
// examples in docs, import path trimmed
import "github.com/redwood/infra/dedicated"
cfg := dedicated.AutoscaleConfig{
  MinReplicas: 2,
  MaxReplicas: 8,
  CooldownSeconds: map[string]int{"scale_out": 30, "scale_in": 300},
}
if err := cfg.Validate(); err != nil {
  panic(err)
}
client.SetAutoscale(cfg)
```
docs-bot: deploy-preview created: https://deploy-preview.redwood.dev/docs/dedicated/autoscale-migrate-4988
ci-bot: linkcheck failed: /docs/dedicated#autoscale-syntax anchor missing; docs-lint complained about codeblock language on Go snippet
diego: i'll fix the anchor and add a tiny docs-parse unit test that loads examples/ and fails fast if keys don't match runtime schema
maya: pinging @felix for quick review on wording and snippet language tag
felix: lgtm, add a one-line note: "Cooldown values are seconds; migrating from the old keys requires mapping to cooldown_seconds.scale_out/scale_in."
maya: will push fixes and small test, thanks all :thumbsup:
